the_simultaneous_bound_had_no_coverage.why_that_fails: a sample with a nonzero mean inherits that mean's own variability under flipping, so the critical value comes out far too small

the_simultaneous_bound_had_no_coverage.fix: the larger of a Bonferroni-corrected t at alpha/(2m) on n-1 degrees of freedom, exact under per-component normality and any dependence, and a quantile of the CENTERED sign-flip studentized-max null, which is mean-invariant

the_simultaneous_bound_had_no_coverage.min_attainable_nonzero_p: 2 / 2^n = 0.03125 at six replicates, because max|t| is invariant under a global sign flip
the_simultaneous_bound_had_no_coverage.correction_to_this_entry: the sign-flip component was described here as valid independently of the error law. That was disproved: centering makes the residuals dependent, so flipping them is not an exact randomization distribution. Measured coverage 0.9597 Gaussian, 0.9677 Laplace, 0.9443 t(3), 0.9283 under a near-discrete Rademacher mixture. Per-component approximate normality is now the REGISTERED coverage assumption. See results/nuisance_review_fixes_provenance.json.

the_margin_could_not_be_justified_and_ti.root_cause: a relative error in a nuisance Jacobian column does not control the principal angle between the nuisance and physiological column spaces, and the Schur complement depends on that angle
the_margin_could_not_be_justified_and_ti.redefinition: column-level equivalence stays as a NECESSARY check that AD matches the ensemble reference; it is not sufficient for a classification. No downstream classification is established by this gate: see correction_to_this_entry.

measured.nearly_orthogonal_block_70.8_deg: the stress search found no flip at a five percent column margin, which is not a certification
measured.nearly_collinear_block_0.0_deg: flips found at every margin down to 1e-5

conditioning_diagnostic.consequence: whether a classification survives perturbation is a property of the measured geometry, not something a margin can guarantee in advance, and a heuristic search cannot establish it either way

the_margin_could_not_be_justified_and_ti.correction_to_this_entry: this entry claimed each classification could be established by propagating the admissible Jacobian set through to it. That was disproved by an explicit counterexample in scripts/stress_search_counterexample.py: the search is a heuristic over a continuum and finding no flip is not a proof of invariance. The routine was renamed to stress_search_classifications and never reports a classification as established. Every downstream classification remains unresolved absent an exhaustive invariance proof. See results/nuisance_review_fixes_provenance.json.
